description: Round postal-red (#9e1b1b) postmark 220x220: double ring 4 px, five wavy cancel lines running right to x 420, blank centre band for the scene's words (POSTE RESTANTE, a date, a regulation number). Parts #ring, #band, #cancels.

Small flat post office 320x300: white walls with 3 px ink outline, postal-red roof band, blank sand sign band (x 40-280, y 70-110) for the scene's words, a door, a small red post box beside it, ground line; no emblem or logo.

White letter sheet 420x560, 3 px ink outline, a blank header line, five grey ruled lines, a signature line bottom right and a small blank chip bottom left (for a fee); the scene letters it (लिखित request, Declaration, पता बदलने की सूचना).
A row of 12 square day tiles 1320x130 (100 px tiles, 10 px gaps), white with 3 px ink outline, blank for the scene's day numbers; parts #tile-1 to #tile-12 so tiles can be tinted.
